limitations.note: The rewrite corrected the one-yuan arithmetic but replaced the original FSM with registered vending outputs, edge-only coin acceptance, simultaneous coin summation, and scheduled change pulses, whereas the correct fix changes only two transition destinations.

The testbench asserted the rewrite’s internal coin pulses and its own simultaneous-coin and change rules instead of checking that the two corrected transitions preserved the original FSM’s input priority and output timing.
